tickets.title: Discover and resolve local owned WSL sessions without manual profiles
acceptance: Discover existing same-user Codex sessions and presentation bindings with account,host,environment,conversation and process generation.
Friendly selectors resolve uniquely; ambiguous, stale and foreign-user targets fail clearly.
No hand-authored session profiles or manual grants needed for ordinary local discovery; preserve existing interfaces.

tickets.title: Make own-session resource limits usable with automatic enforcement readiness
acceptance: Fresh own session can inspect usage and set/tighten voluntary limits without manual per-thread grant setup.
Limit setup starts or explicitly arranges enforcement and reports real readiness; demonstrate bounded stop.
Inherited external ceilings cannot be raised or disabled through self-service; preserve lifetime usage.
validation: worker actualUID1017 bounded3s native paused+stop proof;64focused tests perPython plusfinal4selftests

tickets.title: Expose fresh exact-TUI health for local sessions and codex-bots
acceptance: Observe exact controlling TUI-loop identity and freshness through public CLI and machine-readable owner interface.
Distinguish responsive,stuck,offline and unsupported/unknown without treating process liveness as TUI health.
Ordinary same-user observation requires no manual grants; preserve qualified native probe safeguards.

tickets.title: Submit and retrieve one durable prompt in an existing WSL Codex tab
acceptance: Submit to exact discovered existing conversation with automatic same-user authority/profile binding.
Retain operation ID and distinct submitted/accepted/running/terminal/uncertain states; show response in actual tab.
Prompt final result,wait and exact cancellation reuse existing operation/native owners and never silently retarget or start another conversation.
validation: Public CLI/native Unix wire test PASS Python3.11/3.12

Dedicated signed-in native conversation: submitted exact existing thread,final response retrieved,actual target TUI renders unique answer;retry same intent;3 bounded marker-only provider turns cumulative, no tools

tickets.title: Deliver live text transcript final and silent response modes
acceptance: Support stream,transcript,final,silent caller modes through shared operation contract.
Live output arrives before completion; transcript has ordered model/tool/lifecycle events and resumable cursor with explicit retention/truncation.
Silent success has no normal output; failures nonzero; timeout/disconnect preserves retrievable original operation.

tickets.title: Execute supported native slash commands and surface interactive actions
acceptance: Discover supported slash commands and preserve arguments; use native/harness-specific execution, never ordinary prompt substitution.
Qualify noninteractive and interactive commands, receipt versus execution/completion and explicit interaction handles.
Unsupported commands fail before model submission; same durable tracking/output choices apply.

tickets.title: Use equivalent local session control through PowerShell API and MCP
acceptance: Actual PowerShell client talks to same WSL server and preserves multiline Unicode input and exit status.
CLI/API/local MCP share target,submit,result,event,cancel and output-mode semantics without manual OAuth enrollment for same-owner local use.
Use transport-appropriate streams or operation/event handles; verify no required operation is available only through CLI.

tickets.title: Reconcile disconnect restart busy-state and uncertain delivery safely
acceptance: Fault-inject lost acknowledgement,duplicate retry,disconnect,event cursor resume,timeout/late result and exact cancellation through public operations.
Daemon restart/stale generations do not retarget or repeat native work; busy session behavior is explicit.
Retain unknown effects and reconcile original intent without blind replay; preserve unrelated sessions.

tickets.title: Qualify installed WSL session control and codex-bots consumer acceptance
acceptance: Run confirmed end-to-end seam against installed server from WSL,actual PowerShell,API,local MCP with actual target tab evidence.
Qualify every required output mode,slash interaction,recovery and own-session enforcement row; fixtures alone are insufficient.
Identify codex-bots real consumer contract and qualify machine-readable identity,fresh health,acknowledgement and final result. Record exact source,prefix,builds,commands and final process census.

tickets.title: Qualify Grok on the same session-control contract
acceptance: Grok discovery,prompt,slash capabilities,health,output modes and operation recovery use shared interface.
Truthful per-harness capabilities; qualify supported noninteractive and interactive commands without silent terminal typing fallback.
Installed native acceptance distinguishes true Grok evidence from injected fixtures; no Windows-native or Claude expansion.
